From CNBC's five takeaways on the Trump-Xi summit in Beijing 14 May 2026:

Both countries agreed that Iran can never have a nuclear weapon. Confirmed by a White House official.

The White House said the two leaders agreed on the importance of fully opening the Strait of Hormuz.

Trump statement: Xi Jinping offered to help resolve the US-Iran conflict, saying "If I can be of any help at all, I would like to be of help".

Secretary of State Marco Rubio: Trump raised Iran with Xi but "he didn't ask them for anything"; "We're not asking for China's help. We don't need their help".

Xi warning on Taiwan: mishandling Taiwan will put the US-China relationship in "great jeopardy".

Trump-Xi banquet: Trump called Xi a "friend"; Xi referred to the relationship as "partners, not rivals".

First US presidential trip to Beijing in nearly a decade. Two-day summit format.
